result.instructions: Tools for Parabol, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Parabol data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run parabol_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run parabol_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run parabol_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. parabol_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: get_viewer
tools.title: Get current user (viewer)
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated Parabol user (the token owner): id, preferredName, email, tier, and the team ids (tms) they belong to. Parabol GraphQL: query { viewer { ... } }. Requires the USERS_READ scope. Start here to discover your identity and team ids.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams the viewer belongs to, with each team's id, name, orgId, tier, and team lead. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.teams. Requires the TEAMS_READ scope.

tools.name: get_team
tools.title: Get a team
tools.description: Fetch one team by id: metadata, its team members (with each member's user), active meetings, and organization. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.team(teamId). Requires TEAMS_READ (+ MEETINGS_READ for activeMeetings, ORGS_READ for organization).

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the members of a team, each with role flags (isLead, isOrgAdmin) and the underlying user (preferredName, email). Parabol GraphQL: viewer.team(teamId).teamMembers. Requires TEAMS_READ.

sortBy.description: Optional field to sort members by (e.g. 'preferredName').

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the viewer belongs to: id, name, tier, billingTier. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.organizations. Requires ORGS_READ.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.title: Get an organization
tools.description: Fetch one organization by id, including its teams. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.organization(orgId). Requires ORGS_READ (+ TEAMS_READ for teams).

tools.name: list_organization_users
tools.title: List organization users
tools.description: List the users in an organization (Relay connection): each org-user's role, joinedAt, tier, and underlying user (preferredName, email). Paginate with `first` + `after` (pass the last edge's `cursor`). Parabol GraphQL: viewer.organization(orgId).organizationUsers. Requires ORGS_READ + USERS_READ.

after.description: Cursor for the next page (the `cursor` of the last edge from a prior call).

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.title: List meetings (history)
tools.description: List past/ongoing meetings for one or more teams (Relay connection), newest first. `teamIds` is required. `meetingTypes` defaults to all four (retrospective, action, poker, teamPrompt). `before` bounds the window (defaults to now); paginate older with `after`. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.meetings. Requires MEETINGS_READ.

teamIds.description: Team ids to fetch meetings for (required).

meetingTypes.description: Meeting types to include (MeetingTypeEnum). Defaults to all four.

after.description: DateTime cursor — return meetings before this ISO timestamp (older page).

before.description: DateTime upper bound (ISO). Defaults to now.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.title: Get a meeting
tools.description: Fetch one meeting by id with its phases and stages. For a retrospective it also returns the reflection groups and reflections plus vote/topic/task/comment counts. Uses __typename so you can tell meeting types apart. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.meeting(meetingId). Requires MEETINGS_READ.

tools.name: list_active_meetings
tools.title: List active meetings
tools.description: List a team's currently-active (in-progress) meetings. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.team(teamId).activeMeetings. Requires TEAMS_READ + MEETINGS_READ.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List the viewer's tasks (Relay connection), optionally filtered by team, user, status, archived state, or a text query. Paginate with `first` + the `after` DateTime cursor. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.tasks. Requires TASKS_READ.

after.description: DateTime cursor for the next (older) page (the last edge's cursor).

userIds.description: Filter to tasks assigned to these user ids.

statusFilters.description: Filter by task status (TaskStatusEnum: active, stuck, done, future).

tools.name: parabol_query
tools.title: Run a GraphQL query (read-only)
tools.description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary Parabol GraphQL QUERY (read-only) against action.parabol.co/graphql with optional variables. Mutations are REJECTED — use the dedicated write tools or parabol_graphql for those. Useful for fields not covered by the curated read tools. Requires the matching read scope(s) on your token.

query.description: A GraphQL query document (must be a query, not a mutation).

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data: create a task on a team. Required: teamId and status (active|stuck|done|future). Provide `plaintextContent` for the task text (and/or `content`, which is a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document). Optionally assign to a userId or link to a meetingId/discussionId. Parabol GraphQL: createTask(newTask, area). Requires TASKS_WRITE.

teamId.description: The team id to create the task on (required).

content.description: Rich-text content as a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document.

userId.description: Assign the task to this user id.

meetingId.description: Link the task to this meeting id.

discussionId.description: Link the task to this discussion id (meeting thread).

area.description: Optional AreaEnum context for the task (e.g. 'teamDash', 'meeting').

fields.description: Additional documented GraphQL input fields to send verbatim in this mutation's input (merged OVER the typed fields above).

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data: update an existing task. Required: id. Optionally change content (stringified TipTap JSON), status, assignee (userId), or sortOrder. Only included fields change. Parabol GraphQL: updateTask(updatedTask, area). Requires TASKS_WRITE.

content.description: New rich-text content as a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document.

userId.description: Reassign the task to this user id.

fields.description: Additional documented GraphQL input fields to send verbatim in this mutation's input (merged OVER the typed fields above).

tools.name: create_reflection
tools.title: Create a reflection
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data: add a reflection card to a running retrospective's reflect phase. Required: meetingId, promptId (the reflect-prompt/column), sortOrder (Float). `content` (optional) is a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document (<=2000 chars). Parabol GraphQL: createReflection(input). Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

sortOrder.description: Sort order within the column (Float). Defaults to 0.

content.description: Reflection text as a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document.

fields.description: Additional documented GraphQL input fields to send verbatim in this mutation's input (merged OVER the typed fields above).

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Add a comment
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data: add a comment to a meeting discussion thread. Required: content (stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document), discussionId, threadSortOrder (Int). Optionally isAnonymous or threadParentId (to reply). Parabol GraphQL: addComment(comment) → union. Requires COMMENTS_WRITE.

content.description: Comment body as a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document (required).

threadSortOrder.description: Position within the thread (Int). Defaults to 0.

threadParentId.description: Parent comment id, to post a threaded reply.

fields.description: Additional documented GraphQL input fields to send verbatim in this mutation's input (merged OVER the typed fields above).

tools.name: start_retrospective
tools.title: Start a retrospective
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data: start a new retrospective meeting for a team (returns the new meetingId). Required: teamId. Optionally name it. Parabol GraphQL: startRetrospective → union. Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

teamId.description: The team id to run the retro for (required).

tools.name: start_checkin
tools.title: Start a check-in meeting
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data: start a new Check-in (Action) meeting for a team (returns the new meetingId). Required: teamId. Optionally name it. Parabol GraphQL: startCheckIn → union. Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

tools.name: start_team_prompt
tools.title: Start a standup (team prompt)
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data: start a new async Standup (Team Prompt) meeting for a team. Required: teamId. Optionally name it (default 'Standup'). Parabol GraphQL: startTeamPrompt → union. Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

tools.name: invite_to_team
tools.title: Invite users to a team
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data: send team invitations by email. Required: teamId and invitees (an array of email addresses). Optionally scope to a meetingId. Parabol GraphQL: inviteToTeam(teamId, invitees). Requires TEAMS_WRITE.

teamId.description: The team id to invite into (required).

meetingId.description: Optionally associate the invitation with a meeting id.

tools.name: parabol_graphql
tools.title: Run a GraphQL operation (query or mutation)
tools.description: MUTATES Parabol data (potentially): escape hatch to run an arbitrary Parabol GraphQL operation — including any mutation — against action.parabol.co/graphql with optional variables. Use for operations not covered by the curated tools. Your token must carry the scope the operation requires. Prefer parabol_query for read-only calls.

query.description: A GraphQL query or mutation document.

annotations.title: Run a GraphQL operation (query or mutation)
